title: Scream
subtitle: We've got chaos, deceit, thrills, and arcanists—everything you could ask for!

items.text: The reluctant detective strains to recall every detail amid the chaos.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: The murderer's gotta be somewhere in the auction house. That's the only way they could control their arcane skill so exactly.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Golly. You don't mean to say that the murderer's somewhere in this room?
Her reels skip in shock, nearly coming out of place.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: The ritual might've been set ahead of time. All they had to do was wait for their prey to fall into the trap.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Prey? Right. The killer must have a reason for this, right? But what?

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: She was here for the auction. Oh, heck! They must be killing off club members!

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Please, I'm still thinking things through.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: If all the victims were known club members, the Vigiles wouldn't have been running around in circles. It's too obvious.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: I may not like them very much, but those Vigiles aren't half as thick as the Foundation. Some of them aren't even half-bad.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Hey! We aren't dummies either.
Her protest isn't noted as Ramona carries on.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: But there's one more question that gotta be answered.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: What is this ritual exactly? The energy around it was huge, but they were able to cast it without anyone noticing. That takes true skill.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: There's gotta be some clues around here!
She looks around. Chairs lie on their sides. People rush for the exits. Lights flicker and shake.
The air is filled with curses, screams, and twisted pneuma, while a bitter, biting wind scratches at her senses. She remains clueless.
A smuggler's sudden accusation only makes the situation worse.

items.speaker: Smuggler III
items.text: Hey, you two. Yeah, you! I saw what you did!

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: You pointing at us, sir?

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: It-It wasn't us.

items.speaker: Smuggler III
items.text: Don't act like you're innocent.

items.speaker: Smuggler III
items.text: You were talking to her just before she died.

items.speaker: Smuggler III
items.text: You must have killed her. You're from the Foundation. You're here to kill us all so you can take over the underground arcane materials racket.
Ramona gives up her train of thought to deal with the escalating situation.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: See? This is why I didn't want you tagging along, Metal Head.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Hey, that's not fair. I've helped you a lot, like, like, um ...

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: You're not gonna leave me behind, are you?

items.speaker: Smuggler III
items.text: Guards! These two right here! Take them down!

items.speaker: Smuggler III
items.text: You're trapped in the Turquoise Serpent Club now. There's no escape.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: I hate fighting!
Another attacker falls. Out of breath, she lowers the exorcism tool she's been using as a makeshift weapon.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: *pant* I'm not a fan of making new crime scenes, especially when I'm the one that's going to have to take care of them later.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: We gotta get out of here before we draw any more attention. Latham! Hey, Metal Head!
Loggerhead doesn't respond.
Instead, her attention is drawn to a faint cry for help coming from the stage.

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: Help!

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: Please, my dear clubmates, do not leave me here all alone!

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: Take me away. Throw me back to the deepest, darkest corner of the warehouse. I promise, I'll not say a word about it.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: That painting, she's an Awakened.
The club has descended into bedlam, with no one around to pay any attention to the increasingly frantic painting.

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: Oh, Badía, I know you!

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: You remember me, don't you? The painting from the northwest corner of the warehouse. Next to Antonia and the Cactus Cat.

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: A grubby corner, I must say, haunted, even. None dare walk it but you. You always volunteer to patrol the area, so the others call you a freak.

items.speaker: Lady by the Lake
items.text: But I know why. It's so that you can write those letters to your love in private.

items.speaker: Patroller II
items.text: Ah. Zip it, you overgrown doodle! I don't wanna hear another word!
In the dim light and madness, the auction stage seems like an island of refuge.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Can we take her with us?

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Her? You mean the painting?

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: You outta your mind? She's in the middle of the stage with a goddamn spotlight on her. We may as well get up there and say, "Hey, come get us!"

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: And dying for a blabbermouth painting is not worth what I get paid.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: But we can't just leave her there!

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: She isn't just some arcane tool. She's a living arcanist! She doesn't deserve to be bought and sold like an object!
Loggerhead charges onto the platform.
A gunshot rings out. A bullet skims across her metallic body.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Urgh!

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: ¡Desvío   Neumático!

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Ramona, don't worry about me.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: I'm an Awakened. So, they can't hurt me so easily, at least not with normal bullets.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Heh, guess I forgot it for a second, like I forgot how impulsive you can be.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: At least tell me you've got a plan.

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: What are you gonna do next? I'll cover you.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Oh, hey! We're like those partners in the detective movies.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: *exhale* Focus, Latham. You're a seasoned Foundation employee, an outstanding senior member of the Arcanum Containment Department.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: I grabbed a load of arcane tools before I left. I've gotta have something useful.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: My reels, film developer, Critter-Be-Gone potion, recording plant, infinitely looping drugstore receipt, Encyclopedia of Mexico, seasoning packets, hand-cranked rechargeable battery ...

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: You're made of steel. The hell you need seasoning packets for?

items.speaker: Ramona
items.text: Just how much crap did you bring with you?

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Invisible cloak, crystal phial, sextant, Kangaroo Foam No. 5 Fire Extinguisher ... Ah, here it is!

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Thank goodness the receptionist lady turned down my request to check the disks.
Flustered, she pulls that teleport disk from her pocket and thinks of a destination.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Teleport!
They disappear all at once from the scene, leaving the club in an uproar.

items.speaker: Smuggler III
items.text: Damn it! They escaped.

items.speaker: Smuggler III
items.text: And they took that painting with them.

items.speaker: Smuggler III
items.text: So they are here to sabotage the auction. Those Foundation bastards—can never trust them!

items.speaker: Confused Guest
items.text: Well, at least we're safe from them now. Still, seems like it's time to leave.

items.speaker: Confused Guest
items.text: Or is the auction still on? Are you letting us leave or not, Mr. Pérez?

items.speaker: Angry Guest
items.text: Have you lost it? This auction's a disaster, a joke, I tell you.

items.speaker: Angry Guest
items.text: I intend to have a long talk with Mr. Pérez after this.

items.speaker: "Frightened Guest"
items.text: I can't stay here any longer. For goodness sake, a woman just died!
With the apparent murderers gone, the club settles into an uneasy quiet, whispers spread, and people begin to search for an exit.
At last, the club's security takes the stage and provides the necessary, if foregone, conclusion.

items.speaker: Patroller II
items.text: We're sorry to inform you that today's auction has been put on hold.

items.speaker: Patroller II
items.text: Mr. Pérez was injured in the chaos and is currently unable to host the auction.

items.speaker: Patroller II
items.text: Ms. Luisa has asked us to take everyone out through the emergency exit.

items.speaker: Patroller II
items.text: This way, ma'am.

items.speaker: "Frightened Guest"
items.text: Oh, thank you.
The "frightened guest" presses down on her case to muffle the alarmed squeaks coming from inside.

items.speaker: "Frightened Guest"
items.text: Pardon the noise. I'm allergic to the glow of arcane skills, so I always carry some fresh mandrake with me. Their juice can ease the pain.

items.speaker: "Frightened Guest"
items.text: Though they can be a little rambunctious.

items.speaker: Patroller II
items.text: No need to explain, ma'am. The Turquoise Serpent Club respects the privacy of our members.

items.speaker: Patroller II
items.text: Go through this door. It'll take you back to central Mexico City.
Realizing the futility of their situation, the tiny voices in the case finally fall quiet.

items.speaker: "Frightened Guest"
items.text: Thank you, sir.
